scenario: Critical payment outage crosses client and downtime thresholds
decision_limit: Two materiality thresholds and critical service; remaining official thresholds must still be checked

scenario: Critical service with successful malicious unauthorized access that may cause data loss
decision_limit: Special Article 9(5)(b) pathway assumed; personal-data impact independently assessed

scenario: Critical service with only one known qualifying materiality threshold
decision_limit: Reconsider if other factual criteria emerge

scenario: Noncritical reporting tool disruption meets client and duration metrics
decision_limit: Criticality of affected services requires validation before real classification

scenario: Two closely related ICT events within six months with shared root cause
decision_limit: Article 8(2) recurrence conditions and entity exceptions need evidence; do not auto-classify

scenario: Standalone personal-data disclosure with risk to individuals
decision_limit: GDPR authority assessment independent of DORA service criticality

scenario: Disclosure presenting high risk to affected individuals

decision_limit: Record the breach and the rationale for no authority notification

scenario: Processor alerts controller of personal-data breach
decision_limit: Processor informs controller without undue delay; controller-awareness starts the 72h planning clock
